description: This script 'size_compare.sh' is used to compare the sizes of locally built OpenWrt packages against upstream repositories. It reads configuration files, fetches package data, and outputs size differences to help analyze storage impact of modifications.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Displays the usage information from script comments.

methods.name: package_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a specified package either in installed size or package size based on environment variable.

methods.name: compare_sizes
methods.description: Iterates over packages, compares local and upstream sizes, and outputs differences.
